title: Can AI Agents Be Trusted
subtitle: Trust is an engineered property: scoped capabilities, independent gates and verification

panels.heading: Copilot: Low Risk
panels.caption: The agent summarizes alerts, correlates logs and retrieves the right runbook
panels.note: High leverage, read-only: faster time-to-first-signal with humans in control

panels.heading: Direct Control: High Risk
panels.caption: The agent executes remediation itself, faster than a human can stop a mistake
panels.note: Tool misbinding, hallucinated config and prompt injection under incident pressure

panels.heading: Proposal Plus Gates
panels.caption: The agent prepares a diff; machine-checked gates and approval decide
panels.note: Least privilege, dry runs, preconditions and invariants, and a full audit trail

strip_caption: Expand autonomy only as gates prove precise; keep irreversible actions human-only
